summary: Experiment with retrieval ranking levers now that we have a baseline (golden gate b22586bc + eval harness) and write up the findings. Levers: stratified/per-tradition candidate generation (root-cause fix — the vector pool is corpus-size-biased, so small but fully-tagged traditions like mesopotamian (15 chunks / 103 EXPRESSES) never enter the top-30 candidate set), VECTOR_WEIGHT vs GRAPH_WEIGHT, DIVERSITY_BOOST / rarity weighting, MAX_PER_TRADITION, MATCH_TIER_WEIGHTS, HOP_DEPTH. Principle (agreed): this is about FAIR candidate consideration = good content retrieval, NOT injecting under-showing content regardless of relevance. MUST add a precision counterpart to the golden gate (recall/breadth-only today) so recall tuning cannot mask precision loss; measure each lever against golden recall + the new precision check + eval breadth/latency, and diff top-K vs docs/concept-hierarchy/eval-topk-v3.json. Deliverable: a written report of lever effects at minimum; weight changes ship only if the data supports them.
